faq: I've already signed. Is it too late?
No. If you're inside your cooling-off period, book now and we'll inspect as soon as availability allows. Your report arrives the same day we inspect.
What if the report isn't same day?
Yes. Building and timber pest in one inspection and one report.
Does cooling-off apply to every sale?
Most Victorian private sales have a three business day cooling-off period. Auctions don't, and some sales are exempt, so check your contract or ask your conveyancer.
